Raindrop FX 1.0.8

The browser bundle is vendored for offline use. Local changes: a provenance
comment, removal of the missing source-map reference, and an ES module default
export. Simulation and shaders are the upstream implementation. The embedded
raindrop normal-map texture is part of that implementation. No upstream demo
photograph, wallpaper, sound, or other artwork is included.

Bundled dependencies, as recorded in upstream package-lock.json:
- zogra-renderer 1.3.5, SardineFish, MIT (LICENSE-zogra-renderer)
  https://github.com/SardineFish/zogra-renderer
- gl-matrix 3.4.3, Brandon Jones and Colin MacKenzie IV, MIT (LICENSE-gl-matrix)
  https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix
- reflect-metadata 0.1.13, Microsoft, Apache-2.0
  (LICENSE-reflect-metadata and NOTICE-reflect-metadata.txt)
  https://github.com/rbuckton/reflect-metadata

The Carnet adapter advances simulation from the scene's existing frame clock;
the upstream animation loop is never started. It disables mist and global
background blur, uses the existing photo canvas, and removes evaporated
particles before their mass can become negative in the upstream simulation.
It also supplies the missing source-copy operation for zero-step background
blur in upstream 1.0.8, preserving the original photograph's sharpness.
